verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official CLI for building, testing, and managing a Stripe integration from the command line, including creating a sandbox, and a probe confirms the CLI documentation exists. The evidence is thin on depth, though: it is platform-wide and shows nothing specific to invoicing. Missing for 10: documented invoicing-specific CLI commands (e.g., creating or finalizing invoices), any detail on agent or AI-oriented CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Build, test, and manage your Stripe integration from the command line.
